audience: marketing and sales teams that run webinars and webinar series in WebinarKit

useCases.title: Find a webinar and its scheduled dates
useCases.text: List the webinars on the account with their ids and titles. Then read the scheduled dates and times of the webinar you need.

useCases.title: Review webinar series and meetings
useCases.text: List the webinar series, which group related webinars, and the meetings on the account.

useCases.title: Build an overview of the scheduled events
useCases.text: Combine the webinars, their dates, the series and the meetings to see the scheduled events in one overview.

useCases.title: Look up a white-label sub-account
useCases.text: Read one white-label sub-account by its email address. This works only for white-label accounts.
